evidence.notes: Selected publisher Results and Discussion: native SOF-1 disk-diffusion resistance statement and CMLA6 identification; accession statement AF294653. The beta-lactam MIC table does not supply a chloramphenicol measurement.

added_claims.label: CMLA6-associated chloramphenicol resistance in native isolate SOF-1
added_claims.note: Same-isolate gene/phenotype co-occurrence, not proof that CMLA6 alone caused resistance. The paper names CMLA6 and reports the native isolate phenotype as data not shown; no zone diameter or clinical breakpoint interpretation is inferred. Its beta-lactam experiments in other hosts are not chloramphenicol evidence for this isolate. UniProtKB:Q933G9 is retained as reference context only: it combines CmlA6 and cmlA1 annotations from separate source contexts. The source-reported deposit AF294653.1 is not a genome assembly. No exact experimental protein, allele, strain TaxID or genome is assigned. Compound scope follows named chloramphenicol; the tested preparation was not independently re-identified.

curation_event.changes: Added native SOF-1 CMLA6/chloramphenicol co-occurrence from primary results, without assigning individual causation, an exact experimental UniProt protein, allele or genome. Preserved source-owned assertions and all other fields; whole-record review remains open.
